channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: NHL Hot Seat Radar: Flyers' Rick Tocchet Must Rebound From This Week
item.description: Flyers coach Rick Tocchet, Utah Mammoth bench boss Andre Tourigny and New Jersey Devils star Jack Hughes face pressure this week.

item.title: Olympic Women's Hockey: Canada Face A Disadvantage After Postponed Game
item.description: Canada and Finland's first game of the Olympics was postponed due to a norovirus outbreak affecting the Finns. The time of their rescheduled game could seriously affect Canada's chances of winning gold.

item.title: NHL Nugget: Alpine Aperitivo In Cortina
item.description: With Cortina D'Ampezzo being one of the host cities of the 2026 Winter Olympics, we look at the traditional Italian aperitivo.

item.title: NHL Rumor Roundup: Latest On The Red Wings And Predators
item.description: The Detroit Red Wings could hit the trade market after the Olympic break for help on their blueline, while questions remain over how the Nashville Predators intend to approach the trade deadline.

item.title: Prospect Power Rankings: The Hockey Prospect World Doesn't Stop During Olympics
item.description: This week in our hockey prospect power rankings: a battle of the titans this weekend in the NCAA, a bunch of CHL teams are red-hot, and an interesting question about NHL draft prospect Chase Reid.

item.title: The Hockey News Big Show: Checking In On Some Big NHL Trades
item.description: Katie Gaus, Ryan Kennedy and Michael Traikos revisit the Quinn Hughes and Stuart Skinner trades and discuss Mitch Marner, Seth Jarvis, the latest BetMGM Playbook and more.

item.title: NHL Draft Prospect Gavin McKenna's Felony Charge Withdrawn, Still Faces Three Charges
item.description: NHL draft prospect Gavin McKenna still faces three charges after allegedly punching a 21-year-old man twice, but the aggravated assault charge was withdrawn.

item.title: Could These 10 NHL Veterans Be Playing In Their Last Olympics?
item.description: Longtime NHL veterans, such as Canada's Sidney Crosby and Denmark's Lars Eller, will play crucial roles for their national team at the 2026 Olympics. But will this be their final chance to win an Olympic medal?

item.title: Hockey Canada Picking Seth Jarvis Over Zach Hyman Was An Easy Choice
item.description: Team Canada made another change due to Brayden Point's injury. Adding Carolina Hurricanes star Seth Jarvis instead of Edmonton Oilers winger Zach Hyman is the right decision.

item.title: William Nylander Faces Career-Defining Moments With Sweden And Maple Leafs
item.description: Toronto Maple Leafs star winger William Nylander is facing immense pressure on two fronts this year: in the NHL with the Maple Leafs, and at the 2026 Olympics with Team Sweden.
